featured_reviews.name: DC GAMING
featured_reviews.review_text:
had a very disappointing experience with Viha Enterprises. I visited their service center to repair my BenQ monitor. After checking, the technician told me the motherboard was not working and that they would get back to me with a repair quotation. It took them 10 days just to give a quote, and the cost they mentioned was Rs. 6200 for replacing both the motherboard and power board, with only 90 days warranty.

Honestly, for that price, I could get a brand-new LG Ultragear monitor with a 3-year warranty. So I decided to take my monitor to a local technician. He quickly identified the real issue — moisture on the power board, and fixed it in 2 days for just Rs. 1000. My monitor is now working perfectly.

Viha Enterprises either misdiagnosed the problem or tried to overcharge for unnecessary repairs. Either way, I would not recommend their service based on my experience.
